name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet about shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Bend hips and knees together, keeping the whole foot grounded.
Lower as far as you can control without rounding the lower back.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
cues: Keep knees tracking in the direction of the toes.
Keep pressure through heel, big toe and little toe.
mistakes: Lifting the heels or dropping into the bottom.
breathing: Inhale as you lower; exhale as you stand.
